training_stack: mjlab 1.3.0 (MuJoCo Warp), PPO via RSL-RL, task code in dillonfaulk/microduck_rl (fork-local, not upstream)

training.change_vs_v1: ONE variable: in ball episodes the ball's lateral offset is mirrored to the LEFT foot's kick spot with probability 0.5 (reset_step_target ball_left_prob=0.5), same geometry and +-15 mm noise per side. Everything else is v1's recipe.
training.history_note: v1 got its arrival-posture terms at iteration 1250 (a resume after a crouch failure); v2 trains with them from iteration 0. Same final recipe, different order.
training.gpu: GPU0 only, peak 11.8 GB, 1.46 s/iteration, 1 h 38 min
training.targets: as v1: 65% radius 0-80 mm, 35% 80-250 mm; heading +-15 deg; 10% hold still
training.ball: 70% of episodes, at (0.09, -+0.042) +-15 mm relative to the TARGET stance, side 50/50; moving it > 1 cm terminates the episode (-20); the actor never sees it
training.start: standing, HOME joints +-0.08 rad, +-5 deg roll/pitch
training.penalty_signs: every penalty term <= 0 on every readout, iterations 0-3999
training.checkpoint_choice: 2500 of 2000/2500/3000/3500/3999: missions tie at 60/60; 2500 has the best step battery and arrives closest to HOME (3.6 deg median vs 5.5 at 3999)

contract.obs_layout: same as VelStand: ang_vel 0:3, projected_gravity 3:6, joint_pos_rel 6:20, joint_vel 20:34, last_action 34:48, command 48:61
contract.command: slots 48:51 = REMAINING offset to the target pose in the trunk's current yaw frame [dx m, dy m (left), dyaw rad]; slots 51:61 = 0. Identical to v1: a drop-in replacement.
contract.obs_normalization: baked into the ONNX (scripts/export.py) -- feed raw observations
